book.name: SAN MATEO
book.title: TZOTIꞌ CꞌUL YET COLBANILE TZꞌIBN̈EBILCANO YU NAJ SAN MATEO

content: Islahtiꞌn̈e isba ebnaj Israel yin̈ tzet chu yakꞌni camo ebnaj Comam Jesús
Lahwi yalnicano Comam Jesús huntekꞌan tuꞌ xin, yalni Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom:
—Hex tiꞌ heyohtaj tato cabexan̈e kꞌin̈ Pascua, yin̈ kꞌin̈ tuꞌ xin chinalaxicojan yul iskꞌab anma cat walaxcan̈an yin̈ culus, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, ẍi Comam.
Yin̈ticꞌa huneꞌ tzꞌayic tuꞌ xin, ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj ichamta winaj yul con̈ob tuꞌ, iscutxbaco isba ebnaj bey yatut naj Caifás, naj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote.
Islahtiꞌn̈en isba ebnaj yin̈ tzet lekꞌtiꞌal chal ebnaj yin̈ Comam Jesús, yun̈e istzabnayo ebnaj, cat yakꞌni camo ebnaj Comam yalni.
Yalni ebnaj tet hunun: —Yajaꞌ mach yin̈o kꞌin̈, haxinwal mach chiah bulna anma, ẍi ebnaj.
Yet isjobnayo huneꞌ ix ix an̈ caw xukꞌ sam yiban̈ iswiꞌ Comam Jesús
Yet ayxa Comam Jesús yul con̈ob Betania xin, isto Comam yatut naj Simón, naj ayticꞌaco yabil chiyij lepra yin̈.

Yet ayco Comam waꞌo sat meẍa, yapni huneꞌ ix ix iscꞌatan̈ Comam. Ikꞌbil huneꞌ chꞌen limeta yu ix, alabastro isbi, nohna chꞌen yu huneꞌ an̈ caw xukꞌ sam, yeb caw ay istohol. Isjobnayo ix yiban̈ iswiꞌ Comam.
Hayet yilni ebnaj iscuywom Comam huneꞌ tuꞌ istit ishowal ebnaj yin̈ ix, yalni ebnaj: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin ton̈e chietalaxto huneꞌ an̈ tiꞌ?
Huneꞌ an̈ tiꞌ caw ay istohol, majaltam matxon̈laxtoj, cat ispohlaxcan̈ istohol yin̈ anma mebaꞌ, ẍi ebnaj.
Hayet yaben Comam Jesús huneꞌ tuꞌ, yalni Comam: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin cheyiti hehowal yin̈ ix? Huneꞌ maswatxꞌe ix win̈tiꞌan, caw cꞌul.
Anma mebaꞌ ayn̈eticꞌaco texol, walinan xin mach sunilbal tiempo ayinicꞌojan texol.
Huneꞌ ix tiꞌ masjobayo ix huneꞌ an̈ caw xukꞌ sam wiban̈an yun̈e cꞌulxa ye innimanilan yet chinmujlaxan.
Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, bajxan̈etuꞌwal chihallax Tzotiꞌ cꞌul yet colbanile chihallaxpaxo huneꞌ maswatxꞌe ix tiꞌ, hac tuꞌ xin chiakꞌlax binaho ix, ẍi Comam Jesús tet ebnaj iscuywom.
Yaco naj Judas Comam Jesús yul iskꞌab camical
Naj Judas Iscariote, naj ayco istzꞌajo ebnaj cablahon̈wan̈ iscuywom Comam Jesús, to naj iscꞌatan̈ ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote,
yalni naj tet ebnaj: —¿Hanta cheyakꞌ wetan, chiwacojan naj Jesús yul hekꞌab? ẍi naj. Yalten ebnaj treinta melyu naba plata tet naj.
Hac tuꞌ xin yu yichico naj issayni yin̈ tzet chu yanico naj Comam yul iskꞌab ebnaj.
Yet iswaꞌcano Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj iscuywom yin̈ kin̈ Pascua

Haxa yet yayilo babel tzꞌayic kꞌin̈ Pascua, yet chiwahlax ixim pan machi yan̈al, ishitzico ebnaj iscuywom Comam iscꞌatan̈, iskꞌamben ebnaj: —Mamin, ¿baytuꞌwal chawoche chicowatxꞌehan̈ tzet chicolo yin̈ kꞌin̈ Pascua tiꞌ? ẍi ebnaj.

Istakꞌwi Comam: —Asiꞌwe yul con̈ob, yet chexapnoj cat heto bey yatut huneꞌ naj, cat heyalno tet naj: “Macon̈ischejtijan̈ Comam cuywawom jalan̈ tawet tato hanicꞌxan̈e tiempohal aycꞌo coxolan̈, yuxin haꞌ bey hawatut tiꞌ chon̈hulan̈ jecꞌtzehan̈ kꞌin̈ Pascua tiꞌ yeb Comam,” quexchi, ẍi Comam.
Lahwi tuꞌ, isto ebnaj iscuywom Comam Jesús, isyijen ebnaj hacaꞌticꞌa yu yalni Comam. Yoc ebnaj iswatxꞌen tzet chilolax yin̈ kꞌin̈ Pascua.
Haxa yet yah akꞌbal xin, yoc Comam waꞌo sat meẍa yeb ebnaj cablahon̈wan̈ iscuywom tuꞌ.
Yet lan̈an iswaꞌ Comam yeb ebnaj tuꞌ, yalni Comam: —Yin̈ caw yeli chiwalan teyet, ay huneꞌ mac texol tiꞌ chinanocojan yul iskꞌab camical, ẍi Comam.
Yet yaben ebnaj huneꞌ tuꞌ, caw oc biscꞌulal yin̈ iscꞌul ebnaj. Yoc ebnaj iskꞌambeno tet Comam yin̈ hununtajil: —Mamin, ¿machmitajinan? ẍi ebnaj yin̈ hununtajil.
Istakꞌwi Comam: —Haꞌ huneꞌ mac huneꞌn̈e chu wanaytojan inkꞌaban yul plato yebi haꞌ chinanocojan yul iskꞌab camical.

Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, yilal wecꞌan yin̈ camical, hacaꞌ yalni yul Yum Comam Dios. Yajaꞌ, ¡cꞌanchꞌan naj chinanicojan yul iskꞌab camical! Ayxicꞌa mach pitzcꞌa naj yul sat yiban̈kꞌinal tiꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Naj Judas naj chianico Comam yul iskꞌab camical tuꞌ, iskꞌambe naj: —Mam cuywawom, ¿tom haninan? ẍi naj. Istakꞌwi Comam: —Hoꞌ, hachtoni, ẍi Comam.

Yet lan̈an iswaꞌ Comam, yinican̈ ixim pan, yakꞌni Comam yuchꞌandiosal tet Comam Dios, iskꞌaxponayo Comam ixim. Lahwi tuꞌ yakꞌni Comam ixim tet ebnaj iscuywom; yalni Comam: —Wawej, huneꞌ tiꞌ yechel innimanilan yehi, ẍi Comam.
Yinipaxocan̈ Comam chꞌen vaso, yakꞌni Comam yuchꞌandiosal tet Comam Dios. Lahwi tuꞌ yakꞌni Comam chꞌen vaso tuꞌ tet ebnaj, yalni Comam: —Ucꞌwe huneꞌ tiꞌ hesunil,
yuto haꞌ huneꞌ tiꞌ yechel inchiqꞌuilan chimalto yu istan̈ ismul txꞌiꞌal anma, yun̈e yijnicano isba istrato Comam Dios.
Chiwalpaxojan teyet tato matxa chiwucꞌan yal teꞌ uva masanto yet chioc Inmaman Yahawilal catto wucꞌnihan yin̈ yacꞌtohal hunelxa, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
Yal Comam Jesús ta chal naj Pedro ta mach yohtajo naj Comam
Hayet lahwi isbitn̈encano ebnaj bit tet Comam Dios, isto Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj bey won̈an Olivo.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj iscuywom tuꞌ: —Yin̈ huneꞌ akꞌbal tiꞌ chicabconocan̈ heyanma win̈an hesunil, yuto tzꞌibn̈ebilcano hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Chinpotxꞌan naj tan̈em meꞌ, cat ispujnacanto noꞌ meꞌ tuꞌ,” ẍiayoj.
Yajaꞌ yet chinitzitzbican̈an xin, chinbabitojan tesata bey Galilea, ẍi Comam.
Yalni naj Pedro tet Comam: —Mamin, waxan̈ca sunil mac chicabconcan̈ iscꞌul tawin̈, yajaꞌ walinan, machoj, ẍi naj.
Yalni Comam Jesús tet naj: —Yin̈ caw isyelal chiwalan tawet, yin̈ huneꞌ akꞌbal tiꞌ oxelxa chawala ta mach quinhawohtajojan yet chiokꞌocan̈ noꞌ icham chiyo, ẍi Comam tet naj.
Istakꞌwi naj Pedro: —Waxan̈ca chinakꞌlax camojan tawinta Mamin, yajaꞌ mach chu walnihan ta mach cachwohtajojan, ẍi naj. Hacaꞌticꞌa yu yalni naj Pedro tuꞌ, hac tuꞌ yu yalnipaxo ebnaj sunil.
Txahli Comam Jesús bey Getsemaní
Lahwi tuꞌ xin, isto Comam Jesús yeb ebnaj iscuywom bey huneꞌ peyab chiyij Getsemaní, yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Canan̈wecano tzꞌon̈no bey tiꞌ, chintohan txahlo cosatato tiꞌ, ẍi Comam.
Yinito Comam naj Pedro yeb ebnaj cawan̈ iscꞌahol icham Zebedeo yintaj. Yoc huneꞌ niman biscꞌulal yin̈ yanma Comam, caw xin yaꞌ yuco yin̈ yanma.
Yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —Caw chiwabehan isyaꞌil isbiscꞌulal camical yin̈ wanmahan. Canan̈wecano bey tiꞌ; ¡iwelo hewayan̈ wintajan! ẍi Comam.

Lahwi tuꞌ xin ishitzilo Comam hanicꞌ yin̈ ebnaj, yay jahno Comam, yay xulno sat txꞌotxꞌ. Yichico istxahli: “Mam, ta chisje hacꞌul colinan tet huneꞌ isyaꞌtajil chul wiban̈tiꞌan; yaj mach hacaꞌ chiwochehan, to hacaꞌojab tzet chal hacꞌul,” ẍi Comam.
Lahwi tuꞌ yul Comam bay cancano ebnaj oxwan̈, caw xin chiway ebnaj yet yapni Comam, yalni Comam tet naj Pedro: —¿Tom mach chitecha heyu heyinilo hewayan̈ hunu orahil wintajan?
Iwelo hewayan̈, txahlan̈we tet Comam Dios haxinwal mach chexaycꞌay yul iskꞌab istxꞌojal. Wal heyanma hinan isyijen tzet chal Comam Dios, yajaꞌ wal henimanil xin mach chitecha ilwebal yu, ẍi Comam.
Istopaxo Comam txahlo hunelxa, yalnipaxo Comam yin̈ istxah: “Mam, ta mach chiecꞌayo huneꞌ tiꞌ wiban̈an, yuhojab hacaꞌ chal hacꞌul,” ẍi Comam.
Ismeltzopaxo Comam iscꞌatan̈ ebnaj, caw xin yexn̈e isway ebnaj yuto caw mach chitecha naj wayan̈ yu ebnaj.
Lahwi tuꞌ istopaxo Comam txahlo yin̈ yoxel, hacaꞌticꞌa yu yalni Comam yin̈ babelal yeb yin̈ iscayel, hacticꞌapax tuꞌ yu yalni Comam.

Lahwi tuꞌ xin ismeltzo Comam bay ay ebnaj iscuywom tuꞌ, yalni Comam tet ebnaj: —¿Tom yexn̈eto hewayi, yeb hexewi? Wal tinan̈ maapni yorahil walaxicojan, Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios, yul iskꞌab anma mulum.
Ahan̈wewanoj, ton̈wej yuto lan̈an yul naj chinanicojan yul iskꞌab camical, ẍi Comam tet ebnaj.
Yet istzablaxayo Comam Jesús

Yet lan̈an istzotel Comam Jesús tuꞌ, yapni naj Judas, naj ayco istzꞌajo ebnaj cablahon̈wan̈ iscuywom Comam. Caw xin hantan̈e ebnaj tzujan yinta naj, ikꞌbil yespada yeb isteꞌ ebnaj yu; chejbil ebnaj yu ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yeb ebnaj ichamta winaj iswiꞌehal con̈ob Israel.
Wal xin halbilxa tet ebnaj yu naj Judas tuꞌ yin̈ tzet chu yanico naj Comam yul iskꞌab ebnaj, yet yalni naj: —Haꞌ naj chintzꞌohan iskꞌotx, haꞌ naj chetzabayoj, ẍi naj.
Yuxin hayet ishitzico naj iscꞌatan̈ Comam, yalni naj: —¿Hanicꞌ hawe Mam cuywawom? ẍi naj. Istzꞌohni naj iskꞌotx Comam.
Yalni Comam tet naj: —Hach amigo, haꞌ tzet chihul hawub watxꞌe tinan̈, ẍi Comam. Istit bulna ebnaj istzabnoyo Comam.
Yajaꞌ ay huneꞌ naj iscuywom Comam yihti yespada yul yatut, ispitnilto naj istxiquin huneꞌ ischejab naj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote.
Yalni Comam Jesús tet naj: —Ayto hawespada yul yatut yuto haꞌ mac espada chakꞌa, espada chipotxꞌnipaxo camoj.
¿Tom mach chu inkꞌannihan cablahon̈eb majan ebnaj ángel tet Inmaman tinan̈ ta chiwochehan?
Yajaꞌ ta hac tuꞌ, machim chiyij isba tzet tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yul Yum Comam Dios win̈an bay chala tato yilal yuni huntekꞌan tiꞌ, ẍi Comam.

Lahwi tuꞌ, yalni Comam tet ebnaj apni tuꞌ: —¿Tom elkꞌominan teyet yuxin ikꞌbil heyespada yeb heteꞌ win̈an chexhul quinhetzabnoyojan? Hunun tzꞌayic inbeyan cuywal yul yatut Comam Dios texol, yajaꞌ mach quinhetzabayojan.

Yajaꞌ tinan̈, yilal yuni sunil huntekꞌan tiꞌ yun̈e yijni isba sunil tzet tzꞌibn̈ebilcano yu ebnaj ischejab Comam Dios yet payat, ẍi Comam. Wal ebnaj iscuywom Comam xin elcan̈ ebnaj, yanicano ebnaj Comam ischuquil.
Ilaxto Comam Jesús sat ebnaj iswiꞌehal con̈ob Israel
Lahwi tuꞌ yinito ebnaj Comam Jesús bey yatut naj Caifás, naj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote. Haꞌ bey tuꞌ xin cutxanico ebnaj cuywawom yin̈ isley naj Moisés, yeb ebnaj iswiꞌehal con̈ob.

Wal naj Pedro xin nahat tzujan isto naj yinta Comam, yapni naj yamakꞌil yatut naj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote tuꞌ, yay tzꞌon̈no naj xol ebnaj chitan̈en yatut Comam Dios yu yilni yin̈ tzet chielico Comam.
Wal ebnaj iswiꞌehal yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote yeb ebnaj yahawil yin̈ lahtiꞌ xol ebnaj Israel issay ebnaj mac chioc halno lekꞌtiꞌal yin̈ Comam yun̈e iscawxico camical yiban̈.
Caw xin txꞌiꞌal mac octoj, ishobnican̈ ebnaj lekꞌtiꞌal yin̈ Comam, yajaꞌ maẍticꞌa hunu tzet oc ismulo Comam. Lahwi tuꞌ yapni cawan̈xa ebnaj,
yalni ebnaj: —Huneꞌ naj tiꞌ jabehan̈ yalni naj hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Hanintiꞌan chu wuchcꞌanayojan huneꞌ yatut Comam Dios tiꞌ, cat wanican̈an isselel yin̈ oxeb tzꞌayic,” ẍi naj, ẍi ebnaj yin̈ Comam.
Yah lin̈no naj yahawil yin̈ ebnaj sacerdote, yalni naj tet Comam: —¿Tzet yin̈ xin mach chaẍtakꞌwi? ¿Tzet ye huntekꞌan chal ebnaj tiꞌ tawin̈? ẍi naj.
Yajaꞌ maẍticꞌa takꞌwi Comam tet naj, lahwi tuꞌ yalnipaxo naj: —Yin̈ isbi Comam Dios itzitz, hal yin̈ isyelal jetan̈. ¿Ham hach tiꞌ Cristo, Iscꞌahol Comam Dios? ẍi naj.

Istakꞌwi Comam tet naj: —Hoꞌ, hanintonan hacaꞌ hawalni tiꞌ. Chiwalan teyet tato Hanin Akꞌbilintijan texol yu Comam Dios cheyil woc tzꞌon̈nojan yin̈ iswatxꞌkꞌab Comam Dios caw aycano yip, cat heyilni wulan xol moyan, ẍi Comam.

Yet yaben naj yahawil ebnaj sacerdote tzet yal Comam tuꞌ, istzilnilo naj xil iskꞌap yu ishowal, yalni naj tet ebnaj yetbi tuꞌ: —Huneꞌ mayal naj tiꞌ, caw txꞌoj yul sat Comam Dios. Yuxin tinan̈ matxa yilal chicokꞌan anma chihalni ismul naj, wal xin han̈-caw-on̈ majabe istxꞌojal istzotel naj.
Yuxin, ¿tzet cheyute heyalni hex tiꞌ? ẍi naj. Istakꞌwi ebnaj: —Ay ismul naj, camojab naj, ẍi ebnaj.
Istzublico ebnaj yin̈ sat Comam, ismakꞌnipaxo ebnaj Comam, ay ebnaj xin pakꞌnilto sat Comam,
chalni ebnaj: —Hach Cristo, txumiloj mac macachmakꞌni, ẍi ebnaj tet Comam.
Yal naj Pedro ta mach yohtajo naj Comam Jesús
Yet tzꞌon̈anayo naj Pedro istiꞌ yamakꞌil teꞌ n̈a tuꞌ, ishitzico huneꞌ ix chejab iscꞌatan̈ naj, yalni ix: —Hach tiꞌ hawetbi haba yeb naj Jesús ah Galilea, ẍi ix.
Wal naj Pedro tuꞌ yeba naj yin̈ sat sunil anma, yalni naj: —Mach wohtajojan tzet chawala, ẍi naj.
Haxa yet yapni naj bey ispultahil yamakꞌil teꞌ n̈a tuꞌ, yalni hunxa ix tet anma cutxanico bey tuꞌ: —Naj tiꞌ yetbi isba naj yeb naj Jesús ah Nazaret, ẍi ix.
Yajaꞌ yeba naj hunelxa, yalni naj: —Caw chabe Comam Dios, ¡mach wohtajojan huneꞌ naj tuꞌ! ẍi naj.
Hunepixto xin ishitzico huntekꞌan ebnaj iscꞌatan̈ naj, yalni ebnaj: —Yin̈ caw yeli, hach tiꞌ hawetbi haba yeb ebnaj chiecꞌ yinta naj Jesús tiꞌ yuto ixtan̈ cotxumnilojan̈ hatzoteli, ẍi ebnaj.
Yajaꞌ oc naj Pedro tuꞌ istzꞌactiꞌn̈e isba, yalni naj: —Caw chabe Comam Dios mach wohtajojan huneꞌ naj tuꞌ, ẍi naj. Lan̈antoticꞌa xin yokꞌcan̈ huneꞌ noꞌ icham chiyo.

Hac tuꞌ yu isnaniti naj Pedro yin̈ tzet yal Comam yet yalni Comam hacaꞌ tiꞌ: “Oxelxa chawala ta mach quinhawohtajojan yet chiokꞌcan̈ noꞌ icham chiyo,” ẍi Comam. Lahwi tuꞌ yelti naj Pedro bey tuꞌ, yoc naj okꞌo sicꞌlebil.
